title: How BMW Group accelerated connected vehicle workloads on AWS Graviton
summary: Learn how BMW Group migrated its connected vehicle platform from x86 to AWS Graviton. Using Karpenter, multi-architecture container builds, and Graviton-based CI/CD runners, the team moved workloads without disruption, cutting NGINX ingress CPU by about 57 percent and delivering about 40 percent better price-performance.

title: Automating agentic AI Well-Architected reviews with the AWS Agentic AI Lens
summary: Smarsh used the AWS Well-Architected Framework's Agentic AI Lens to review its first agentic workload. Because the lens is not yet selectable in the console, the team encoded it as a Claude skill that assessed all 150 best practices against the workload's GitHub repository and produced an evidence-backed review workbook in hours instead of days.

title: How Anchorage Digital and Turnkey verify code with AWS Nitro Enclaves
summary: Anchorage Digital and Turnkey built verifiable infrastructure on AWS Nitro Enclaves so crypto wallets can cryptographically verify which code parsed a transaction. title: Automate medical coding with Step Functions and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
summary: Learn how to combine deterministic orchestration with bounded agentic reasoning using AWS Step Functions and the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness. This medical coding workflow escalates cheapest-first: a safety block-list, then exact matching, then an AI agent only for terms that need judgment, keeping every routing decision auditable.
